Author: Miw360
Name: Aether Exporter
Punchline: Exports relic material counts and your inventories to your own profile.
Description: Reads relic weapon materials and, when you enable it on the site, your whole inventory, armoury chest, chocobo saddlebag and retainers (with market listings), and sends them to your own profile on an external site after you pair the character. It only reads; it never moves, sells or uses anything.
